23.label: Attacks per Second
23.text: Amount of attacks performed in a second.

27.label: Increased Jumping Power
27.text: Increases how far you can jump.

22.label: Attack Damage
22.text: The amount of damage your attacks deal.

33.label: to Strength
33.text: Every point in Strength increases your Attack Damage by 1%.

36.label: to Dexterity
36.text: Every point in Dexterity increases your Attack Rating by 8 and your Critical Damage by 0.125%.

39.label: to Energy
39.text: Every point in Energy increases your Mana by 4. Mana gained from Energy also increases your base Mana Replenish.

42.label: to Intelligence
42.text: Every point in Intelligence increases Magic Skill Damage dealt.

45.label: to Armor
45.text: Every point in Armor increases your Defense by 5.

48.label: to Vitality
48.text: Every point in Vitality increases your Life by 5. Life gained from Vitality also increases your base Life Replenish.

57.label: Life stolen per Hit
57.text: Amount of Life replenished when striking an enemy.

58.label: Life per second
58.text: Amount of Life replenished each second.

59.label: Life After each Kill
59.text: Amount of Life replenished after killing a monster.

64.label: Mana stolen per Hit
64.text: Amount of Mana replenished when striking an enemy.

65.label: Mana per second
65.text: Amount of Mana replenished each second.

66.label: Mana After each Kill
66.text: Amount of Mana replenished after killing a monster.

68.label: Increased Attack Speed
68.text: Amount of increased Attack Speed. Percentual Attack Speed is always calculated using 0.75 Attacks Per Second.

72.label: Increased Critical Strike Chance
72.text: Chance for a Critical Strike when striking. Only affects physical attacks.

73.label: Increased Critical Strike Damage
73.text: Amount of your Critical Strike damage. Only affects physical attacks.

74.label: to Attack Rating
74.text: Increases your chance of hitting enemies with attacks.

78.label: Slows target by
78.text: Attacks slow enemy Movement and Attack Speed.

94.label: of target Defense ignored
94.text: Ignores enemy Defense rating making it easier to hit the target.

95.label: Chance for a Deadly Blow
95.text: Deadly Blow increases your Physical Damage by 35%

97.label: Chance for a Crushing Blow
97.text: Crushing Blow breaks enemy armor by 10% stacking up to 5 times increasing physical damage taken by enemies.

99.label: Chance to Open Wounds
99.text: Open Wounds bleeds target enemy for 20% of your Physical Damage.

101.label: Magic Skill Damage increased by
101.text: Increases the damage of your Skills excluding skills which deal Attack Damage. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

128.label: to Physical Damage
128.text: Physical Damage added to your attacks.

132.label: to Additive Fire Damage
132.text: Fire Damage added to your attacks.

134.label: Fire Skill Damage increased by
134.text: Increases the damage of your Fire skills. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

135.label: to Enemy Fire Resistance
135.text: The amount of enemy Fire resistance ignored when dealing Fire Damage.

136.label: to Additive Cold Damage
136.text: Cold Damage added to your attacks.

138.label: Cold Skill Damage increased by
138.text: Increases the damage of your Cold skills. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

139.label: to Enemy Cold Resistance
139.text: The amount of enemy Cold resistance ignored when dealing Cold Damage.

140.label: to Additive Arcane Damage
140.text: Arcane Damage added to your attacks.

142.label: Arcane Skill Damage increased by
142.text: Increases the damage of your Arcane skills. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

143.label: to Enemy Arcane Resistance
143.text: The amount of enemy Arcane resistance ignored when dealing Arcane Damage.

144.label: to Additive Lightning Damage
144.text: Lightning Damage added to your attacks.

146.label: Lightning Skill Damage increased by
146.text: Increases the damage of your Lightning skills. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

147.label: to Enemy Lightning Resistance
147.text: The amount of enemy Lightning resistance ignored when dealing Lightning Damage.

148.label: to Additive Poison Damage
148.text: Poison Damage added to your attacks.

150.label: Poison Skill Damage increased by
150.text: Increases the damage of your Poison skills. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

151.label: to Enemy Poison Resistance
151.text: The amount of enemy Poison resistance ignored when dealing Poison Damage.

154.label: Defense
154.text: Defense lowers the chance of enemies hitting you with Physical Attacks or Projectiles.

157.label: Block Chance
157.text: The chance to block incoming attacks and projectiles.

160.label: Magic Damage Taken Reduced by
160.text: Reduces incoming Magic Damage such as Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison and Arcane

162.label: Damage Taken Reduced by
162.text: Reduces a flat amount of damage from every source. This stat is additive and does not scale from anything.

170.label: Faster Hit Recovery
170.text: Increases the speed of recovery after being hit by an attack or projectile.

171.label: Damage Returned to the Attacker
171.text: Amount of damage returned to the attacker.

173.label: to All Resistances
173.text: Increases your resistance against damage from All Elements.

175.label: to Fire Resistance
175.text: Increases your resistance to Fire damage.

177.label: to Cold Resistance
177.text: Increases your resistance to Cold damage.

179.label: to Lightning Resistance
179.text: Increases your resistance to Lightning damage.

181.label: to Arcane Resistance
181.text: Increases your resistance to Arcane damage.

183.label: to Poison Resistance
183.text: Increases your resistance to Poison damage.

191.label: Fire Damage Absorbed
191.text: Absorbs a portion of all incoming Fire Damage as healing.

192.label: Cold Damage Absorbed
192.text: Absorbs a portion of all incoming Cold Damage as healing.

193.label: Poison Damage Absorbed
193.text: Absorbs a portion of all incoming Poison Damage as healing.

194.label: Lightning Damage Absorbed
194.text: Absorbs a portion of all incoming Lightning Damage as healing.

195.label: Magic Damage Absorbed
195.text: Absorbs a portion of all incoming Arcane Damage as healing.

196.label: Faster Cast Rate
196.text: Increases your Casting speed. Faster Cast Rate is always calculated using 1 Cast Per Second.

201.label: to All Skills
201.text: Increases the level of all Skills.

222.label: to Physical Skills
222.text: Increases the level of all Physical Skills.

223.label: to Cold Skills
223.text: Increases the level of all Cold Skills.

224.label: to Arcane Skills
224.text: Increases the level of all Arcane Skills.

225.label: to Fire Skills
225.text: Increases the level of all Fire Skills.

226.label: to Lightning Skills
226.text: Increases the level of all Lightning Skills.

227.label: to Poison Skills
227.text: Increases the level of all Poison Skills.

281.label: to Light Radius
281.text: Effects your visibility range and base movement speed scaling.

282.label: Increased Experience Gain
282.text: Increases your experience gained from killing monsters.

284.label: Increased Magic Find
284.text: Increased chance of finding magic items. (Mercenary’s Magic Find is added to player Magic Find on kills).

286.label: Extra Gold Dropped From Kills
286.text: Extra gold dropped from monsters when killed.

290.label: Decreased Merchant Prices
290.text: Discounted prices when buying from the Merchant.
